final: SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM scanfeatures AS sf JOIN sites AS s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY share_of_total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
